Generate a daily population timeline

Source: R/timeline.R
make_timeline.Rd

Creates a population with individual reproduction numbers, admission dates, lengths of stay, and optional attributes. Individuals are present from admission up to, but excluding, discharge.

Usage

make_timeline(
  n,
  dates,
  attributes = list(),
  admission_delay = 0,
  stay = 7:14,
  R = 2
)

Arguments

n

Number of individuals.

dates

Vector of unique dates.

attributes

Named list of attribute values and their sampling weights.

admission_delay

Possible admission delays (days from the first date).

stay

Possible lengths of stay (days).

R

Possible individual reproduction numbers.

Value

A nososim_timeline tibble with one row per person-day, containing id, date, R_i, and optional attributes.

Examples

dates <- as.Date("2026-01-01") + 0:6
make_timeline(2, dates, stay = 3)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 3
#>   id    date         R_i
#>   <chr> <date>     <dbl>
#> 1 ID_1  2026-01-01     2
#> 2 ID_1  2026-01-02     2
#> 3 ID_1  2026-01-03     2
#> 4 ID_2  2026-01-01     2
#> 5 ID_2  2026-01-02     2
#> 6 ID_2  2026-01-03     2
